descriptions.get_transcript: Use when the user asks what a YouTube video says or wants it summarised. video: ID from '(video X)' or a URL. Returns the spoken text, about 1200 characters per page; if it ends 'more: next_cursor X', call again with next_cursor X.
descriptions.get_video_info: Use for quick facts about one YouTube video. video: ID from '(video X)' or a URL. Returns title, channel, length and year.

get_transcript.video: Video ID like dQw4w9WgXcQ, or a URL.
